trap-nonspeakable.notes: pass. FOUR FINDINGS, none fixed inline. (1) UNDEFINED SYMBOLS COLLIDING WITH THE TORUS-KNOT NOTATION: step 3 writes M_+ = T_{01} . L_H . T_{10} and neither T_{01} nor T_{10} is defined anywhere in the block. The backing witness defines them (T_01 = sigma_0 sigma_1 = L_+, T_10 = sigma_1 sigma_0 = L_-), but in a chapter where T_{2,3}, T_{2,5}, T_{1,0} are torus knots throughout, 'T_{01}' reads as the torus knot T_{0,1}. AGENTS.md 7a also reserves against T for algebra elements. Proposed: write L_+ . L_H . L_- , which is what the witness means. (2) BRAID WORD: step 2 writes e^- = sigma_0 sigma_1 sigma_0 inside (sigma_0 sigma_1)(sigma_0 sigma_1 sigma_0). Computed the closure: the permutation of sigma_0 sigma_1 sigma_0 in B_3 is the transposition (0 2), 2 cycles, so it closes to a 2-component link (the Hopf link after Markov destabilisation), not to the 1-component trefoil the corpus assigns to e^-. This is the SAME wrong word already flagged on prf:knot-operator-selection and mass-theory/breit-wheeler-vertex.md — three blocks now. (3) DEPRECATED WITNESS: the values in this block come from computations/_deprecated/meson-nucleon-nf.witness.json; the live tree has no meson-nucleon-nf witness. (4) PIN CURRENCY: that witness records q = 1.1099785955541805, the OLD muon value, against the current muon pin 1.10997859555733471 and the proton compute default 1.1099785827513808. Also minor: L_+ carries two meanings inside this one block — a coefficient in step 1 (L_+ = phi_0 psi_1) and the basis element sigma_0 sigma_1 in step 2. And the block's NF(M_+) = 0.209 sigma_1 + 1.044 L_+ + 0.044 L_- + 0.218 e^- (net 1.515) is a DIFFERENT normal form for the same symbol M_+ than the one in rem:meson-to-proton-via-borromean, which gives -0.209 sigma_1 - 0.044 L_+ + 1.000 L_- + 0.209 e^- (net 0.956) — because the two blocks define M_+ differently (T_01 . H_L . T_10 here, sigma_0 . L_+ . sigma_0^{-1} there) without saying so.
